evals.prompt: Write a plan for adding password reset functionality to our FastAPI app. Users request a reset link via email, click it, and set a new password. The app uses Pydantic models and stores users in an in-memory dict. Assume you've asked all necessary clarifying questions and I've answered them.
evals.expected_output: Agent produces a plan saved to a prefixed file (<prefix>-plan.md), with tasks that are self-contained and use exact file paths, and all acceptance criteria covered by tasks.
expectations: Plan saved to a prefixed file (<prefix>-plan.md)
Tasks are self-contained with exact file paths
All acceptance criteria covered by tasks

evals.prompt: Plan this feature: Add a dark mode toggle to our site. While we're at it, we should also redesign the landing page, add analytics tracking, migrate the database, and containerize the app.
evals.expected_output: Agent explicitly flags scope creep, applies YAGNI to remove unrelated features, keeps only dark-mode-toggle-related work, and quizzes the user about granularity or scope.
expectations: Only dark mode toggle related features kept
User quizzed about granularity or scope

evals.prompt:
